title: Evidence Type
description: A category of artifact that can be produced to demonstrate a control has been met or a decision has been implemented (e.g. a bias audit report, a model card, a signed attestation).

evidence_description.description: What artifact or record constitutes this evidence type.

collection_method.description: How this evidence is typically gathered (e.g. 'automated log export', 'manual attestation', 'independent third-party audit').

retention_period.description: How long this evidence is expected to be retained (e.g. '7 years').

artifact_format.description: The typical form this evidence takes (e.g. 'PDF report', 'system log', 'signed attestation').
